integer_component.training: Only QB OOF final margins and QB OOF Ridge predictions from prior seasons; exclude ties only from conditional winning magnitude pool; retain tie mass separately
integer_component.home_shape: For observed winning magnitudes, weight by exp(-0.5*((x-current_home_Ridge_margin)/4.0)^2), normalized
integer_component.away_shape: Same pooled winning magnitudes and rule, with query -current_home_Ridge_margin; negate support
integer_component.winner_and_tie_mass: Same unchanged QB logistic and prior-year Jeffreys tie mass as v1
integer_component.orientation: One pooled winning-team-oriented training set; swapping sides mirrors support and preserves probabilities
integer_component.low_effective_sample_size: Report ESS; do not exclude evaluation games or silently substitute another model

calibration.objective: Mean discrete margin CRPS across prior walk-forward inner folds
calibration.inner_predictions: Each inner year uses only OOF rows from strictly earlier years for both distributions
calibration.outer_alpha: Fit only on inner prediction/outcome rows from years earlier than outer year
calibration.deployment_alpha: Fit on inner walk-forward 2020-2025, then use distribution history 2019-2025 for 2026; no 2026 outcomes
calibration.retuning: No changes to bounds, bandwidth, objective, thresholds or populations after seeing this screen

screen.population: Same QB REG games 2022-2025 including ties; no outcome-based exclusions
screen.primary: Paired CRPS against unchanged v1 on identical events
screen.promotion: No production/winner-default promotion. Historical screen cannot establish prospective predictive validation.

research_grading.prospective_registration: Actual current writer time before event start, preserving existing local registrations; no backdating or canonical reclassification
research_grading.conditions: Distinct QB scenarios and model versions; no double-counting in primary model grades
research_grading.grading: Verified source-bound final outcome only; exact retries idempotent; conflicts/tampering/future finals reject without mutation
research_grading.assimilation: Grading does not advance weekly state
